436	   436	# --- arms and tasks -----------------------------------------------------------------------
437	   437	[[ -n "$ARMS_CSV" ]] || ARMS_CSV="$(jq -r '(.arms // [] | map(select(.absent == true) | .id)) as $absent
438	   438	                                            | [.priority // [] | .[] | select(IN($absent[]) | not)] | join(",")' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
439	   439	IFS=',' read -r -a ARMS <<<"$ARMS_CSV"

441	   441	for a in "${ARMS[@]}"; do

443	   443	  def="$(jq -c --arg a "$a" '[.arms // [] | .[] | select(.id == $a)][0] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"

448	   448	
449	   449	ALL_TASKS=()
450	   450	while IFS= read -r d; do ALL_TASKS+=("$d"); done < <(cd "$TDIR" && for d in */; do d="${d%/}"; [[ -f "$d/task.yaml" ]] && printf '%s\n' "$d"; done | LC_ALL=C sort)
451	   451	[[ ${#ALL_TASKS[@]} -gt 0 ]] || die "no tasks under $TDIR"
452	   452	SEL_TASKS=()

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# run-ablation.sh — the cycle-130 ablation batch runner (SDD §5.9, §3.4; sprint Task 3.2;
     4	# DEC-0405, DEC-0407, DEC-0413, DEC-0417, DEC-0418, DEC-0428, DEC-0429, DEC-0435, DEC-0545,
     5	# DEC-0553, DEC-0554)
     6	#
     7	# Plans a batch (arm × applicable task × trial), dispatches every trial to
     8	# pipeline-run.sh against a pinned source tree, checks after each trial that the arm
     9	# took effect and that the CLI version and model ids did not drift, grades the run,
    10	# writes its runs.jsonl row, and keeps MANIFEST.json and STATUS.json for the batch.
    11	#
    12	# Usage:
    13	#   run-ablation.sh --arms CSV --source-commit SHA [--tasks CSV] [--types CSV]
    14	#                   [--trials-build N] [--trials-review N] [--max-usd USD] [--run-cap USD]
    15	#                   [--concurrency 3] [--batch NAME] [--results-root DIR] [--rows F]
    16	#                   [--suite-root DIR] [--suite-file F] [--image IMG] [--executor container|host]
    17	#                   [--pre-registration-ref TEXT] [--seed N] [--self-check-log F]
    18	#                   [--smoke] [--dry-run] [--resume] [--detach] [--clear-arm ID]...
    19	#                   [--clear-drift] [--rerow RUN_ID]... [--rerun RUN_ID]... [--rerun-status S]...
    20	#                   [--pipeline-bin P] [--grade-bin G] [--row-bin R] [--took-effect-bin T]
    21	#                   [--docker-bin D]
    22	#
    23	# Options:
    24	#   --arms CSV           arm ids in the order given (default: the suite's priority minus
    25	#                        every arm declared absent: true); each must be declared
    26	#   --source-commit SHA  the Loa commit the arms run (the pinned source tree)
    27	#   --tasks CSV          task ids (default: every <suite-root>/tasks/<id>/task.yaml;
    28	#                        --smoke: every smoke/<id>/)
    29	#   --types CSV          keep tasks of these types (feature-build, bug-fix, refactor,
    30	#                        review-catch; `build` = the three build types)
    31	#   --trials-build N     trials per build task (default the suite's trials.build; --smoke 1)
    32	#   --trials-review N    trials per review-catch task (default trials.review-catch; --smoke 1)
    33	#   --max-usd USD        batch spend cap (see Spend); no cap when absent
    34	#   --run-cap USD        per-run cap passed to pipeline-run.sh --max-run-usd and reserved per
    35	#                        running trial (default evals.ablation.run_cap_usd in .loa.config.yaml,
    36	#                        else the suite's caps.run_usd, else 12)
    37	#   --concurrency N      trials at once, 1-9 (default 3)
    38	#   --batch NAME         batch directory name (default batch-<UTC ts>; --smoke smoke-<UTC ts>;
    39	#                        the smoke- prefix is reserved for --smoke)
    40	#   --results-root DIR   where batch directories live (default
    41	#                        grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/batches; --smoke
    42	#                        evals/results/ablation-2.0)
    43	#   --rows F             the rows file (default: --smoke <batch>/rows.jsonl; otherwise
    44	#                        grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl, the tracked file, or
    45	#                        <results-root>/runs.jsonl when --results-root is given). A smoke
    46	#                        batch never writes the tracked file (DEC-0428: smoke rows decide nothing)
    47	#   --suite-root DIR     suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0)
    48	#   --suite-file F       suite file (default evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml)
    49	#   --image IMG          container image (default loa-ablation:258)
    50	#   --executor MODE      container (default) or host; passed to pipeline-run.sh and the grader
    51	#                        (host grading needs LOA_EVAL_ALLOW_HOST_GRADING=1, see ablation-grade.sh)
    52	#   --pre-registration-ref TEXT  the NOTES pre-registration heading and timestamp (MANIFEST)
    53	#   --seed N             shuffle seed (default 20261015)
    54	#   --self-check-log F   the recorded image self-check (default
    55	#                        grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-259/self-check-image.log)
    56	#   --smoke              smoke batch: smoke/ tasks, one trial each, no hard gate, own rows
    57	#   --dry-run            run the pre-flight, print the plan, write MANIFEST.json only
    58	#                        (MANIFEST.dry-run.json when the batch already has a STATUS.json)
    59	#   --resume             continue --batch NAME from its MANIFEST.json, STATUS.json and rows
    60	#   --detach             re-exec under setsid nohup (log <batch>/driver.log), print the batch
    61	#                        directory and the pid, exit 0
    62	#   --clear-arm ID       with --resume: remove ID from STATUS.json paused_arms (repeatable)
    63	#   --clear-drift        with --resume: re-read the run named by STATUS.json drift (its run dir
    64	#                        <batch>/<arm>/<task>-t<n>, or the highest -r<k> sibling) with the
    65	#                        current drift guard; none → drift null, an entry in drift_cleared[] and
    66	#                        the batch continues; still a drift → exit 2 printing it, nothing written
    67	#   --rerow RUN_ID       with --resume: run the post-run chain (took-effect, drift guard, grade,
    68	#                        ablation-row.sh with the old row's attempts and retry_reason) again
    69	#                        over the run dir of RUN_ID and replace its one row in place, under the
    70	#                        rows file's flock (temp file beside it, --validate, mv); repeatable;
    71	#                        before reconciliation, so spend and per_arm count the new row once.
    72	#                        Refused (exit 2, nothing written) when RUN_ID is not <batch>-… or not
    73	#                        in the plan, has no row or more than one, has no run dir, or its row
    74	#                        is interrupted or transport_error (those trials are reruns)
    75	#   --rerun RUN_ID       with --resume (DEC-0553): launch RUN_ID again, at its plan index, into a
    76	#                        fresh -r<k> run dir; when its new row lands it replaces the old row in
    77	#                        place (replace_row, under the flock) and STATUS.json rerun[] gets
    78	#                        {run_id, from, to, old_cost_usd, at}. The row must be transport_error,
    79	#                        interrupted or infrastructure_error, else exit 2 with nothing written
    80	#                        (also: not <batch>-…, not in the plan, no row or more than one, or the
    81	#                        same id also given to --rerow); repeatable
    82	#   --rerun-status S     with --resume: rerun every row of the batch whose status is S, one of
    83	#                        transport_error, interrupted, infrastructure_error (anything else is a
    84	#                        usage error); read after the rerows, and a --rerow id is never rerun;
    85	#                        repeatable. A flagged row leaves the done set: no counter and no
    86	#                        assumed charge, only its reported cost stays in spent (it moves to
    87	#                        ledger_usd when the replacement lands); the in-flight reservation
    88	#                        covers the new trial and its row is accounted once when it lands
    89	#   --pipeline-bin P, --grade-bin G, --row-bin R, --took-effect-bin T, --docker-bin D
    90	#                        the five collaborators (defaults: the scripts beside this one, and
    91	#                        $EVAL_DOCKER_BIN else docker)
    92	#
    93	# Pre-flight (any refusal: exit 2, nothing written but <batch>/REFUSED.txt with the reason):
    94	#   1. hard gate, non-smoke batches only (DEC-0435): <suite-root>/MANIFEST.sha256 present,
    95	#      the self-check log present with at least 2 × tasks + review-catch tasks lines
    96	#      `…: PASS` (36 for the sixteen-task suite) and no `: FAIL` line, a REVIEW.md in every
    97	#      <suite-root>/tasks/<id>/; their sha256 go to MANIFEST.json gate
    98	#   2. freeze.sh --check --root <suite-root> --suite-file <suite-file> (it runs
    99	#      validate-suite.sh), with --smoke when MANIFEST.sha256 lists a smoke/ path or the batch
   100	#      is a smoke batch (the manifest is checked as it was frozen)
   101	#   3. seed-corpus-from-record.sh --check (the review-catch corpus SHA256SUMS)
   102	#   4. container: the docker CLI and the image (`docker image inspect`)
   103	#   5. the pinned source tree: $LOA_ABLATION_SOURCE_TREE when set (tests; must be a git tree
   104	#      at the commit, with .claude/), else a detached worktree
   105	#      $LOA_ABLATION_CACHE/ablation-src-<sha12> (default ~/.cache/loa) cut from
   106	#      $LOA_ABLATION_SOURCE_REPO (default this repository) with git worktree add --detach;
   107	#      it must be at the commit and pristine (git status --porcelain --ignored empty)
   108	#   --resume also refuses when the source commit, the suite manifest hash, the image digest
   109	#   or the CLI version differ from MANIFEST.json, or when STATUS.json records a drift
   110	#   (unless --clear-drift re-reads that run clean under the current rule).
   111	#
   112	# Plan: arms × tasks × trials. An arm whose task_types excludes a task's type is dropped for
   113	# that task with one `refused:` line and never dispatched (DEC-0405). The order is
   114	# trial-major (every arm × task once before any second trial); inside each trial block the
   115	# entries (arm-major, tasks by id) are shuffled with one python3 random.Random(<seed>)
   116	# generator, blocks in trial order (Fisher-Yates via random.shuffle: reproducible for a seed
   117	# across CPython 3.x). run_id = <batch>-<arm>-<task>-t<n>; run dir <batch>/<arm>/<task>-t<n>,
   118	# a fresh <…>-r<k> (k ≥ 2) for a transport retry or a resumed rerun (the run_id stays).
   119	# --dry-run prints `plan: …`, the `refused:` lines and one line per trial
   120	# `<arm> <task> <type> <trial> <run_id>`.
   121	#
   122	# Per trial, in order: pipeline-run.sh --task-yaml … --arm … --run-dir … --run-id … --trial …
   123	#   --source-tree <pinned> --suite-file … --executor … --image … --docker-bin …
   124	#   --max-run-usd <run-cap>, output to <batch>/<arm>/<task>-t<n>.log; then
   125	#   1. status from meta/pipeline.json (missing or `running` → interrupted; a missing record
   126	#      is written as a minimal pipeline.json with synthesized_by: run-ablation.sh)
   127	#   2. transport: agent_error plus a provider signature in the failing phase's
   128	#      stderr-<label>.log or events-<label>.jsonl (lib/arms-common.sh
   129	#      is_pipeline_transport_failure) is retried ONCE after $LOA_ABLATION_RETRY_WAIT_S
   130	#      (default 120) into a fresh run dir: attempts 2, retry_reason; the first attempt writes
   131	#      no row and its spent_usd counts in spend; a second transport failure is rowed
   132	#      transport_error. agent_error without the signature is never retried (DEC-0417)
   133	#   3. took-effect.sh --run-dir D --suite-file F (completed, agent_error and cap_failure runs):
   134	#      a FAIL rows the trial infrastructure_error and pauses the arm (STATUS.json
   135	#      paused_arms; no further trial of it launches until --resume --clear-arm ID) (DEC-0418)
   136	#   4. drift guard (DEC-0407 as amended by DEC-0545): a phase drifts on model grounds only
   137	#      when its model_requested differs from MANIFEST phase_models[name], or when the
   138	#      requested model (else the manifest's) is absent from a non-empty models_used (ids
   139	#      normalised as ablation-row.sh does: no Bedrock region prefix, no -vN:M suffix). Any
   140	#      other models_used key is an extra model, telemetry and not drift (Claude Code's
   141	#      WebFetch summariser or a built-in subagent): one `run-ablation: extra model <id> in
   142	#      <labels> (<N> output tokens; …)` line in the trial log, the trial result's
   143	#      extra_models and STATUS.json extra_models. The transcripts' system/init
   144	#      claude_code_version (or version) equals MANIFEST cli_version (when neither carries a
   145	#      version, pipeline.json image_digest must equal MANIFEST image_digest). A mismatch rows
   146	#      the trial infrastructure_error, records STATUS.json drift, launches nothing more and
   147	#      fails the batch once the running trials end
   148	#   5. ablation-grade.sh D <task> --suite-root … [--tasks-dir smoke] --executor … --image …
   149	#      --docker-bin … (scored runs that passed 3 and 4; exit 2 → row infrastructure_error)
   150	#   6. ablation-row.sh --run-dir D --task-yaml F --manifest <batch>/MANIFEST.json
   151	#      --attempts N [--retry-reason R] [--status S] --out <job row>; the runner appends the
   152	#      row to the rows file under flock and runs ablation-row.sh --validate on it
   153	#      (--allow-ungraded for smoke) and refuses a run_id rowed twice (state failed)
   154	#   Watchdog (DEC-0429): a trial whose pipeline has no final meta/pipeline.json status after
   155	#   twice its phase-sum timeout (the planned phases' timeout_min: task bounds, else the
   156	#   suite's phase_defaults, BARE = PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 × FIX) gets SIGTERM to its process
   157	#   group, SIGKILL after $LOA_ABLATION_WATCHDOG_GRACE_S (default 60), and is rowed
   158	#   interrupted. $LOA_ABLATION_WATCHDOG_S replaces the deadline (seconds; tests).
   159	#   Outage breaker (DEC-0554): $LOA_ABLATION_OUTAGE_BREAKER (default 3; 0 disables) consecutive
   160	#   collected trials rowed transport_error (collection order, any arm; any other collected
   161	#   trial resets the count) stop further launches; the running trials end, STATUS.json outage
   162	#   is set and the batch finishes partial (exit 1): `partial (outage breaker): N consecutive
   163	#   transport failures; --resume --rerun-status transport_error after the network is back`.
   164	#
   165	# Spend (--max-usd, SDD §5.5 reused through lib/arms-common.sh): before each launch,
   166	#   spent + in_flight × run_cap + est_next > max waits for a running trial and
   167	#   spent + est_next > max cuts (no further launches; STATUS.json cuts[] gets {reason,
   168	#   spent, in_flight_reserved, max, est_next, trials_launched, at_trial}; exit 1).
   169	#   est_next = the mean cost of this arm's completed trials of the task kind (build |
   170	#   review-catch), else the kind's pooled mean, else the suite's cost_hint[kind]. spent =
   171	#   rows' cost_usd + transport first attempts' spent_usd + assumed charges: a trial ending
   172	#   neither completed nor with a reported cost is charged run_cap, a cap_failure is charged
   173	#   max(cost, run_cap); both count in spend.assumed_cap_trials when the charge exceeds the
   174	#   reported cost.
   175	#
   176	# Files: <results-root>/<batch>/{MANIFEST.json, STATUS.json, run.log, spend.txt,
   177	#   REFUSED.txt, driver.log, .gitignore (non-smoke: the run directories and logs stay out of
   178	#   git), <arm>/<task>-t<n>[-r<k>]/ (pipeline-run.sh run dirs), <arm>/<task>-t<n>.log};
   179	#   rows to the rows file. MANIFEST.json (§3.4): schema_version, suite, batch, dry_run,
   180	#   smoke, created, source_commit, source_worktree, source_commit_dot_claude_delta (git diff
   181	#   --stat 4d69c3c4..<commit> -- .claude/, ≤ 4,000 chars), harness_commit, harness_dirty,
   182	#   suite_file, suite_root, tasks_dir, rows_file, suite_version, suite_manifest_sha256, arms,
   183	#   tasks, refused, trials_per_type, trials_planned, plan, arm_map, shuffle_seed, shuffle,
   184	#   fingerprint, image, image_digest, executor_mode, cli_version (`docker run --rm --network
   185	#   none <image> claude --version`, host: the CLI's), cli_version_raw, tools, phase_models,
   186	#   caps {cycle_usd, run_usd, reserve_usd, max_usd}, cost_hint, concurrency, retry,
   187	#   watchdog, pre_registration_ref, gate (null for smoke), corpus, agy_opt_in, environment.
   188	#   STATUS.json (§3.4), rewritten after every trial: {schema_version, suite, batch, smoke,
   189	#   state: running|complete|partial|failed, per_arm: {<arm>: {trials_planned, launched,
   190	#   completed, failed (agent_error), excluded (transport_error, infrastructure_error,
   191	#   interrupted, contaminated), cap_failures, degraded, skipped_paused}}, retries: [{run_id,
   192	#   reason, first_attempt_usd}], cuts: [...], paused_arms: {<arm>: reason}, spend: {rows_usd,
   193	#   ledger_usd (transport first attempts, and the reported cost of rows a rerun replaced), spent_usd, max_usd, assumed_cap_trials}, resume_cursor (the
   194	#   index of the first plan entry without a row), drift: null | {run_id, field, expected,
   195	#   got}, drift_cleared: [{run_id, previous, cleared_at, harness_commit}] (--clear-drift),
   196	#   rerowed: [{run_id, from, to, at}] (--rerow), rerun: [{run_id, from, to, old_cost_usd, at}]
   197	#   (--rerun, --rerun-status), rerun_pending: [run_id…] (flagged, no replacement yet), outage:
   198	#   null | {at, consecutive, last_run_id, message} (the breaker), outage_history: [the
   199	#   outages a later --resume cleared], extra_models: {<raw id>: {runs,
   200	#   output_tokens}} ({} when none; derived from extra_models_by_run: {<run_id>: {<raw id>:
   201	#   output_tokens}}, the per-run source a rerow replaces), rows_invalid, started,
   202	#   finished}. At the end the spend.sh line and a batch line go to <batch>/spend.txt.
   203	#
   204	# --resume: reads MANIFEST.json (plan, arms, suite paths, executor, image, run cap, rows
   205	#   file) and STATUS.json (paused_arms, cuts, retries, first-attempt spend); a plan run_id
   206	#   with a row of this batch is done; a trial without a row reruns into a fresh -r<k> run
   207	#   dir (the stale dir is kept); counters and spend are recomputed from the rows.
   208	#   --max-usd and --concurrency may change on resume; --clear-arm, --clear-drift and

   764	run_dir_of() {  # run_dir_of <run_id> → <batch>/<arm>/<task>-t<n> or its highest -r<k> sibling; empty when none
   765	  local rel base best k max=1 d
   766	  rel="$(jq -r --arg r "$1" '[.[] | select(.run_id == $r) | .run_dir][0] // ""' "$WORK/plan-only.json")"
   767	  [[ -n "$rel" ]] || return 0
   768	  base="$BATCH_DIR/$rel" best=""
   769	  [[ -d "$base" ]] && best="$base"
   770	  for d in "$base"-r*; do
   771	    [[ -d "$d" ]] || continue
   772	    k="${d##*-r}"; [[ "$k" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || continue
   773	    if [[ $k -gt $max ]]; then max=$k best="$d"; fi
   774	  done
   775	  printf '%s' "$best"
   776	}
   777	CLEAR_PENDING=null
   778	if [[ "$CLEAR_DRIFT" == true ]]; then
   779	  old_drift="$(jq -c '.drift' "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json")"
   780	  if [[ "$old_drift" == null ]]; then
   781	    echo "run-ablation: resume: --clear-drift: the batch records no drift; nothing to clear" >&2
   782	  else
   783	    cd_rid="$(jq -r '.run_id // ""' <<<"$old_drift")"
   784	    cd_rd="$(run_dir_of "$cd_rid")"
   785	    [[ -n "$cd_rd" && -f "$cd_rd/meta/pipeline.json" ]] || die "resume: --clear-drift: no run dir with meta/pipeline.json for the drifted run $cd_rid"
   786	    cd_now="$(drift_check "$cd_rd" "$cd_rid" | sed -n 1p)" || cd_now=""
   787	    [[ -n "$cd_now" ]] || die "resume: --clear-drift $cd_rid: the drift guard could not read $cd_rd"
   788	    [[ "$cd_now" == null ]] || die "resume: --clear-drift $cd_rid: the run still drifts under the current rule: $cd_now"
   789	    CLEAR_PENDING="$(jq -cn --arg r "$cd_rid" --argjson prev "$old_drift" --arg at "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
   790	      --arg hc "$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)" \
   791	      '{run_id: $r, previous: $prev, cleared_at: $at, harness_commit: $hc}')"
   792	  fi
   793	fi
   794	RR_K=() RR_RD=() RR_FROM=() RR_ATT=() RR_REASON=()
   795	for rid in ${REROW_IDS[@]+"${REROW_IDS[@]}"}; do
   796	  [[ "$rid" == "$BATCH-"* ]] || die "--rerow $rid: not a run of batch $BATCH (<batch>-<arm>-<task>-t<n>)"
   797	  k=-1
   798	  for j in "${!PL_RUN[@]}"; do [[ "${PL_RUN[$j]}" == "$rid" ]] && { k=$j; break; }; done
   799	  [[ $k -ge 0 ]] || die "--rerow $rid: not in the batch's plan"
   800	  [[ -f "$ROWS" ]] || die "--rerow $rid: no rows file $ROWS"
   801	  rr_rows="$(jq -R -c --arg b "$BATCH" --arg r "$rid" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .batch == $b and .run_id == $r)' "$ROWS")"
   802	  rr_n="$(grep -c . <<<"$rr_rows" || true)"
   803	  [[ "$rr_n" -eq 1 ]] || die "--rerow $rid: $rr_n rows in $ROWS (a rerow replaces exactly one)"
   804	  rr_st="$(jq -r '.status' <<<"$rr_rows")"
   805	  case "$rr_st" in interrupted|transport_error) die "--rerow $rid: the row is $rr_st; that trial is a rerun (--resume after removing the row), not a rerow" ;; esac
   806	  rr_rd="$(run_dir_of "$rid")"
   807	  [[ -n "$rr_rd" && -f "$rr_rd/meta/pipeline.json" ]] || die "--rerow $rid: no run dir with meta/pipeline.json under $BATCH_DIR"
   808	  RR_K+=("$k"); RR_RD+=("$rr_rd"); RR_FROM+=("$rr_st")
   809	  RR_ATT+=("$(jq -r '.attempts // 1' <<<"$rr_rows")"); RR_REASON+=("$(jq -r '.retry_reason // ""' <<<"$rr_rows")")
   810	done
   811	for rid in ${RERUN_IDS[@]+"${RERUN_IDS[@]}"}; do
   812	  [[ "$rid" == "$BATCH-"* ]] || die "--rerun $rid: not a run of batch $BATCH (<batch>-<arm>-<task>-t<n>)"
   813	  k=-1
   814	  for j in "${!PL_RUN[@]}"; do [[ "${PL_RUN[$j]}" == "$rid" ]] && { k=$j; break; }; done
   815	  [[ $k -ge 0 ]] || die "--rerun $rid: not in the batch's plan"
   816	  [[ -f "$ROWS" ]] || die "--rerun $rid: no rows file $ROWS"
   817	  rn_rows="$(jq -R -c --arg b "$BATCH" --arg r "$rid" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .batch == $b and .run_id == $r)' "$ROWS")"
   818	  rn_n="$(grep -c . <<<"$rn_rows" || true)"
   819	  [[ "$rn_n" -eq 1 ]] || die "--rerun $rid: $rn_n rows in $ROWS (a rerun replaces exactly one)"
   820	  rn_st="$(jq -r '.status' <<<"$rn_rows")"
   821	  case "$rn_st" in transport_error|interrupted|infrastructure_error) ;;
   822	    *) die "--rerun $rid: the row is $rn_st; only transport_error, interrupted or infrastructure_error rows are rerun (DEC-0553)" ;; esac
   823	done
   824	
   825	# --- batch directory, lock, manifest ---------------------------------------------------
   826	mkdir -p "$BATCH_DIR"
   827	LOCK="$BATCH_DIR/.lock"
   828	rmdir_lock() { find "$LOCK" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || true; }
   829	if ! mkdir "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null; then
   830	  oldpid="$(cat "$LOCK/pid" 2>/dev/null || echo "")"
   831	  if [[ -n "$oldpid" ]] && kill -0 "$oldpid" 2>/dev/null; then die "batch $BATCH is locked by pid $oldpid ($LOCK)"; fi
   832	  rm -rf "$LOCK"; mkdir "$LOCK" || die "cannot lock $LOCK"
   833	fi
   834	printf '%s\n' "$$" > "$LOCK/pid"
   835	JOBS_DIR="$BATCH_DIR/.jobs"
   836	# a driver killed with SIGKILL leaves its pipelines running in their own sessions: never start
   837	# a second copy of a trial while the first still spends
   838	for f in "$JOBS_DIR"/*.pgid; do
   839	  [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
   840	  read -r p _ < "$f" 2>/dev/null || continue
   841	  if [[ "$p" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && kill -0 -- "-$p" 2>/dev/null; then
   842	    rmdir_lock
   843	    die "a pipeline of an earlier driver still runs (process group $p, $f); stop it (kill -TERM -- -$p) or wait, then resume"
   844	  fi
   845	done
   846	rm -rf "$JOBS_DIR"; mkdir -p "$JOBS_DIR"
   847	rm -f "$BATCH_DIR/REFUSED.txt"
   848	LOG="$BATCH_DIR/run.log"
   849	if [[ "$SMOKE" != true && ! -f "$BATCH_DIR/.gitignore" ]]; then
   850	  printf '%s\n' "# run-ablation.sh: run directories, logs and job state stay out of git;" \
   851	    "# MANIFEST.json, STATUS.json and spend.txt are the batch record" "/*/" "/run.log" "/driver.log" "/.lock/" "/.jobs/" \
   852	    > "$BATCH_DIR/.gitignore"
   853	fi
   854	[[ "$RESUME" == true ]] || write_manifest "$MAN_PATH" false
   855	mkdir -p "$(dirname "$ROWS")"
   856	
   857	# --- batch state ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   858	STATE=running STARTED="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
   859	SPENT=0 ASSUMED_CAP=0 CUT_JSON=null LAUNCHED=0 ROWS_USD=0 LEDGER_USD=0
   860	CUTS_JSON='[]' RETRIES_JSON='[]' PAUSED_JSON='{}' DRIFT_JSON=null ROWS_INVALID=null STOP="" SIGNALLED=false
   861	EXTRA_RUNS_JSON='{}' DRIFT_CLEARED_JSON='[]' REROWED_JSON='[]'
   862	RERUN_JSON='[]' RERUN_OLD='{}' OUTAGE_JSON=null OUTAGE_HISTORY_JSON='[]' OUTAGE_RUN=0
   863	DONE_LIST=$'\n' RERUN_LIST=$'\n'
   864	C_PLANNED=() C_LAUNCHED=() C_COMPLETED=() C_FAILED=() C_EXCLUDED=() C_CAP=() C_DEGRADED=() C_SKIPPED=()
   865	for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do
   866	  C_PLANNED[$i]=0; C_LAUNCHED[$i]=0; C_COMPLETED[$i]=0; C_FAILED[$i]=0; C_EXCLUDED[$i]=0; C_CAP[$i]=0; C_DEGRADED[$i]=0; C_SKIPPED[$i]=0
   867	done
   868	arm_index() { local i; for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do [[ "${ARMS[$i]}" == "$1" ]] && { echo "$i"; return; }; done; echo -1; }
   869	for a in ${PL_ARM[@]+"${PL_ARM[@]}"}; do i="$(arm_index "$a")"; C_PLANNED[$i]=$(( ${C_PLANNED[$i]} + 1 )); done
   870	is_done() { [[ "$DONE_LIST" == *$'\n'"$1"$'\n'* ]]; }
   871	is_rerun() { [[ "$RERUN_LIST" == *$'\n'"$1"$'\n'* ]]; }   # flagged on resume, no replacement row yet
   872	is_paused() { jq -e --arg a "$1" 'has($a)' <<<"$PAUSED_JSON" >/dev/null; }
   873	
   874	# account_row <arm> <kind> <run_id> <status> <cost> <degraded> — counters and spend for one row
   875	account_row() {
   876	  local arm="$1" kind="$2" rid="$3" st="$4" cost="$5" deg="$6" i
   877	  i="$(arm_index "$arm")"
   878	  [[ "$cost" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$ ]] || cost=0
   879	  case "$st" in
   880	    completed) C_COMPLETED[$i]=$(( ${C_COMPLETED[$i]} + 1 )) ;;
   881	    cap_failure) C_CAP[$i]=$(( ${C_CAP[$i]} + 1 )) ;;
   882	    agent_error) C_FAILED[$i]=$(( ${C_FAILED[$i]} + 1 )) ;;
   883	    *) C_EXCLUDED[$i]=$(( ${C_EXCLUDED[$i]} + 1 )) ;;
   884	  esac
   885	  [[ "$deg" == true ]] && C_DEGRADED[$i]=$(( ${C_DEGRADED[$i]} + 1 ))
   886	  ROWS_USD="$(fadd "$ROWS_USD" "$cost")"
   887	  if [[ "$st" == cap_failure ]]; then
   888	    if awk -v c="$cost" -v r="$RUN_CAP" 'BEGIN { exit !(c < r) }'; then
   889	      SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$RUN_CAP")"; ASSUMED_CAP=$((ASSUMED_CAP + 1))
   890	      log "assumed cap: $rid ended cap_failure at USD $cost; USD $RUN_CAP charged to spent"
   891	    else
   892	      SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$cost")"
   893	    fi
   894	  else
   895	    spend_charge "$st" "$cost" "$rid"
   896	    if [[ "$st" == completed ]]; then est_record "$arm|$kind" "$kind" "$CHARGED_COST"; fi
   897	  fi
   898	}
   899	
   900	resume_cursor() { local k; for k in "${!PL_RUN[@]}"; do is_done "${PL_RUN[$k]}" || { echo "$k"; return; }; done; echo "$PLAN_N"; }
   901	write_status() {
   902	  local per='{}' i finished=null
   903	  for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do
   904	    per="$(jq -c --arg a "${ARMS[$i]}" --argjson p "${C_PLANNED[$i]}" --argjson l "${C_LAUNCHED[$i]}" \
   905	      --argjson c "${C_COMPLETED[$i]}" --argjson f "${C_FAILED[$i]}" --argjson x "${C_EXCLUDED[$i]}" \
   906	      --argjson cap "${C_CAP[$i]}" --argjson d "${C_DEGRADED[$i]}" --argjson s "${C_SKIPPED[$i]}" \
   907	      '. + {($a): {trials_planned: $p, launched: $l, completed: $c, failed: $f, excluded: $x, cap_failures: $cap,
   908	                   degraded: $d, skipped_paused: $s}}' <<<"$per")"
   909	  done
   910	  [[ "$STATE" != running ]] && finished="\"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\""
   911	  jq -n --arg batch "$BATCH" --argjson smoke "$SMOKE" --arg state "$STATE" --argjson per "$per" \
   912	    --argjson retries "$RETRIES_JSON" --argjson cuts "$CUTS_JSON" --argjson paused "$PAUSED_JSON" \
   913	    --arg rows_usd "$ROWS_USD" --arg ledger "$LEDGER_USD" --arg spent "$SPENT" --arg max "$MAX_USD" \
   914	    --argjson assumed "$ASSUMED_CAP" --argjson cursor "$(resume_cursor)" --argjson drift "$DRIFT_JSON" \
   915	    --argjson invalid "$ROWS_INVALID" --arg started "$STARTED" --argjson finished "$finished" \
   916	    --arg src "$SRC_FULL" --arg rows "$ROWS" --argjson planned "$PLAN_N" --argjson signalled "$SIGNALLED" \
   917	    --argjson ebr "$EXTRA_RUNS_JSON" --argjson cleared "$DRIFT_CLEARED_JSON" --argjson rerowed "$REROWED_JSON" \
   918	    --argjson rerun "$RERUN_JSON" --argjson pending "$(printf '%s' "$RERUN_LIST" | sed '/^$/d' | jq -R . | jq -sc .)" \
   919	    --argjson outage "$OUTAGE_JSON" --argjson ohist "$OUTAGE_HISTORY_JSON" \
   920	    '{schema_version: 1, suite: "ablation-2.0", batch: $batch, smoke: $smoke, state: $state, per_arm: $per,
   921	      retries: $retries, cuts: $cuts, paused_arms: $paused,
   922	      spend: {rows_usd: ($rows_usd | tonumber), ledger_usd: ($ledger | tonumber), spent_usd: ($spent | tonumber),
   923	              max_usd: (if $max == "" then null else ($max | tonumber) end), assumed_cap_trials: $assumed},
   924	      trials_planned: $planned, resume_cursor: $cursor, drift: $drift, drift_cleared: $cleared, rerowed: $rerowed,
   925	      rerun: $rerun, rerun_pending: $pending, outage: $outage, outage_history: $ohist,
   926	      extra_models: ([$ebr | to_entries[] | .value | to_entries[]] | group_by(.key)
   927	                     | map({key: .[0].key, value: {runs: length, output_tokens: (map(.value) | add)}}) | from_entries),
   928	      extra_models_by_run: $ebr, rows_invalid: $invalid, signalled: $signalled,
   929	      source_commit: $src, rows_file: $rows, started: $started, finished: $finished}' > "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json.tmp"
   930	  mv "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json.tmp" "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json"
   931	}
   932	
   933	cleanup() {
   934	  local f p
   935	  for f in "$JOBS_DIR"/*.pgid; do
   936	    [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
   937	    read -r p _ < "$f" || continue
   938	    kill -TERM -- "-$p" 2>/dev/null || kill -TERM "$p" 2>/dev/null || true
   939	  done
   940	  for p in $(jobs -p 2>/dev/null); do kill "$p" 2>/dev/null || true; done
   941	  rm -rf "$JOBS_DIR" "$LOCK" "$WORK" 2>/dev/null || true
   942	}
   943	trap cleanup EXIT
   944	
   945	# --- one trial (a background job; its result goes to $JOBS_DIR/<jid>.*) -------------
   946	fresh_dir() { local b="$1" k=2; [[ -e "$b" ]] || { printf '%s' "$b"; return; }; while [[ -e "$b-r$k" ]]; do k=$((k + 1)); done; printf '%s' "$b-r$k"; }
   947	final_status() {  # final_status <run-dir> → the pipeline status, empty when missing or running
   948	  local s; s="$(jq -r '.status // ""' "$1/meta/pipeline.json" 2>/dev/null || true)"
   949	  case "$s" in completed|agent_error|cap_failure|infrastructure_error|interrupted) printf '%s' "$s" ;; *) printf '' ;; esac
   950	}
   951	synthesize_record() {  # synthesize_record <run-dir> <arm> <task> <type> <trial> <run_id> <reason>
   952	  local rd="$1"
   953	  mkdir -p "$rd/meta"
   954	  [[ -f "$rd/meta/arm" ]] || printf '%s\n' "$2" > "$rd/meta/arm"
   955	  if ! jq -e 'type == "object"' "$rd/meta/pipeline.json" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   956	    jq -n --arg r "$6" --arg a "$2" --arg t "$3" --arg ty "$4" --argjson n "$5" --arg src "$SRC_FULL" --arg why "$7" \
   957	      --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --arg mode "$EXECUTOR" \
   958	      '{schema_version: 1, run_id: $r, arm: $a, task_id: $t, task_type: $ty, trial: $n, source_commit: $src,
   959	        status: "interrupted", reason: $why, cap_phase: null, spent_usd: 0, executor_mode: $mode, phases: [],
   960	        snapshots: {}, started: $now, finished: $now, synthesized_by: "run-ablation.sh"}' > "$rd/meta/pipeline.json"

1	     1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	     2	# =============================================================================
3	     3	# ablation-report.py — the cycle-130 ablation report (PRD FR-8, SDD §5.12, §4.2)
4	     4	#
5	     5	# Reads runs.jsonl rows (SDD §3.1, ablation-row.sh), the batch MANIFEST.json files
6	     6	# (SDD §3.4, run-ablation.sh) and the suite file (evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml:
7	     7	# arms[], trials, cut_ladder, priority and the pre-registered `rules` block, D-A5),
8	     8	# applies the pre-registered rules to every component arm (A2 … A7) against the
9	     9	# control a1_full, checks H1 (a1_full vs a0_bare) and the A4 sensitivity rule, and
10	    10	# writes report.md (and a --json twin with the same numbers).
11	    11	#
12	    12	# Usage:
13	    13	#   ablation-report.py --runs F [--runs F ...] --manifests DIR [--manifests DIR ...]
14	    14	#                      --suite F --out report.md [--json report.json]
15	    15	#                      [--seed 20261015] [--resamples N] [--level L]
16	    16	#                      [--exclude-degraded true|false] [--partial]
17	    17	#                      [--cuts F] [--not-run CSV]
18	    18	#
19	    19	# Options:
20	    20	#   --runs F            a runs.jsonl file (repeatable). Every non-blank line is one row
21	    21	#                       and must carry schema_version 1 (an integer, or a "1.x" string);
22	    22	#                       a row with another major, no schema_version, or a line that is not
23	    23	#                       a JSON object stops the report (exit 2, naming file:line and run_id).
24	    24	#                       A run_id seen twice keeps its last row (the earlier one is listed).
25	    25	#   --manifests DIR     a directory searched recursively (symlinks not followed) for
26	    26	#                       MANIFEST.json files (repeatable). Each gives a batch's provenance:
27	    27	#                       batch, arm_map, shuffle_seed, source_commit, suite_manifest_sha256,
28	    28	#                       suite_version, pre_registration_ref, cli_version (top level or
29	    29	#                       executor.cli_version), image_digest, smoke. A manifest with an
30	    30	#                       unknown schema_version major, two manifests claiming one batch, or
31	    31	#                       an arm_map entry disagreeing with a row's arm → exit 2.
32	    32	#   --suite F           the suite file: YAML read through `yq -o=json` (mikefarah yq v4,
33	    33	#                       as arms-report.py does), or JSON when the file parses as JSON.
34	    34	#                       The Method section quotes its `rules:` block verbatim.
35	    35	#   --out F             report.md (the only files written are --out and --json; a symlink
36	    36	#                       at either path is refused)
37	    37	#   --json F            the JSON twin (schema_version 1)
38	    38	#   --seed N            bootstrap seed (default 20261015); every interval uses its own
39	    39	#                       random.Random(seed), so a figure does not depend on which other
40	    40	#                       arms are present
41	    41	#   --resamples N       default rules.bootstrap.resamples (10,000); a value other than the
42	    42	#                       pre-registered one is marked in the header
43	    43	#   --level L           default rules.bootstrap.level (0.90); same marking
44	    44	#   --exclude-degraded  true (default) | false: rows with degraded: true are excluded
45	    45	#                       pairwise (rules.exclusion.statuses names `degraded`)
46	    46	#   --partial           prints "PARTIAL — rows so far, no decision is final"; exit 1 when no
47	    47	#                       comparison (A2–A7, H1, A4) has a valid pair on every primary it uses
48	    48	#   --cuts F            a JSON list of {arm, reason, figure[, state]} the lead recorded;
49	    49	#                       arm is an id (a5_no_flatline) or a label (A5); state is not_run_cut
50	    50	#                       (default) or inconclusive_by_power (a pre-declared power cut)
51	    51	#   --not-run CSV       arm ids or labels read as Not run (cut) with figure "--not-run"
52	    52	#
53	    53	# Row treatment (DEC-0393, DEC-0417):
54	    54	#   not decided, listed  rows of a smoke batch (manifest smoke: true), rows whose batch has
55	    55	#                        no manifest, rows of an arm the suite does not run (absent or
56	    56	#                        unknown), rows on a task type outside the arm's task_types
57	    57	#                        (applicability refusals; not counted in the excluded share)
58	    58	#   excluded pairwise    status in rules.exclusion.statuses plus transport_error and
59	    59	#                        infrastructure_error (DEC-0417), degraded: true (with
60	    60	#                        --exclude-degraded true), and a scoring status whose primary is
61	    61	#                        null (ungraded); the task-trial cell leaves BOTH arms of every
62	    62	#                        comparison it is in; a cell holding a valid row (a rerun) is valid
63	    63	#   cap_failure          0 on every applicable primary (pass rate 0, every defect missed)
64	    64	#   completed, agent_error  score what the row holds (hidden_test_pass_rate; defects)
65	    65	#   The sensitivity figure repeats the comparison with cap_failure excluded pairwise
66	    66	#   instead of scored 0; no decision reads it.
67	    67	#
68	    68	# Statistics (pre-registered in the suite's rules block; formulas in the Method section):
69	    69	#   pass rate unit  the task: per task, the mean over its valid trials, arm minus a1_full
70	    70	#   catch-rate unit the defect: per review-catch task and defect dK, the share of the
71	    71	#                   arm's valid trials that caught it, arm minus a1_full; per-defect ids
72	    72	#                   come from the row's `defects_missed` (or `recall.missed`) list of dK
73	    73	#                   ids when present, else each defect of the task takes the row's
74	    74	#                   defect_catch_rate (aggregate rows); the task-level figure is also
75	    75	#                   reported (rules.bootstrap.also_report) and decides nothing
76	    76	#   interval        percentile bootstrap of the mean paired difference: `resamples`
77	    77	#                   resamples with replacement, linear interpolation between order
78	    78	#                   statistics, [lo, hi] = the (1-level)/2 and 1-(1-level)/2 quantiles
79	    79	#   d               the mean of the paired differences (not the bootstrap mean)
80	    80	#   c, w            cost and wall-clock delta in percent against a1_full,
81	    81	#                   (mean_arm − mean_a1) / mean_a1 × 100, over the per-task means of the
82	    82	#                   cells the primaries paired
83	    83	#   MDE             (z(1−(1−level)/2) + z(0.90)) × sd(paired diffs) / sqrt(n): the smallest
84	    84	#                   true mean difference a paired test at the report level detects with 0.90
85	    85	#                   power at the available n; n < 2 → n/a
86	    86	#   comparisons     every predicate compares values rounded to 9 decimals, so a planted
87	    87	#                   −0.03 reads −0.03 and not −0.030000000000000027
88	    88	#
89	    89	# Decision per arm (rules.predicates, first match, DEC-0416, with DEC-0393's guard first):
90	    90	#   the degradation guard (excluded share > rules.exclusion.inconclusive_above_share →
91	    91	#   inconclusive, labelled Inconclusive-by-degradation, whatever the interval) →
92	    92	#   investigate → keep → inconclusive (d < -0.03 or no valid pair) → remove → simplify. Then: an arm named by --cuts / --not-run reads
93	    93	#   Not run (cut) or Inconclusive-by-power with the lead's figure; an arm whose MDE on an

180	   180	def percentile(sorted_xs, q):
181	   181	    """Linear interpolation between order statistics (numpy's default 'linear')."""
182	   182	    n = len(sorted_xs)
183	   183	    if n == 0:
184	   184	        return None
185	   185	    pos = q * (n - 1)
186	   186	    lo = int(math.floor(pos))
187	   187	    hi = min(lo + 1, n - 1)
188	   188	    frac = pos - lo
189	   189	    return sorted_xs[lo] + (sorted_xs[hi] - sorted_xs[lo]) * frac

192	   192	def bootstrap(diffs, resamples, level, seed):
193	   193	    if not diffs:
194	   194	        return None, None
195	   195	    rng = random.Random(seed)
196	   196	    n = len(diffs)
197	   197	    means = sorted(sum(rng.choices(diffs, k=n)) / n for _ in range(resamples))
198	   198	    a = (1.0 - level) / 2.0
199	   199	    return percentile(means, a), percentile(means, 1.0 - a)

202	   202	def mde(diffs, level):
203	   203	    if len(diffs) < 2:
204	   204	        return None
205	   205	    nd = statistics.NormalDist()
206	   206	    z = nd.inv_cdf(1.0 - (1.0 - level) / 2.0) + nd.inv_cdf(POWER)
207	   207	    return z * statistics.stdev(diffs) / math.sqrt(len(diffs))

210	   210	def collapse(run_ids):
211	   211	    """batch-arm-task-t1, -t2, -t3 → batch-arm-task-t1…t3 (non-contiguous: t1,t3)."""
212	   212	    groups, other = {}, []
213	   213	    for rid in run_ids:
214	   214	        m = re.fullmatch(r"(.*-t)(\d+)", rid)
215	   215	        if m:
216	   216	            groups.setdefault(m.group(1), []).append(int(m.group(2)))
217	   217	        else:
218	   218	            other.append(rid)
219	   219	    out = []
220	   220	    for prefix in sorted(groups):
221	   221	        ns = sorted(set(groups[prefix]))
222	   222	        if len(ns) == 1:
223	   223	            out.append(f"{prefix}{ns[0]}")
224	   224	        elif len(ns) >= 3 and ns == list(range(ns[0], ns[-1] + 1)):
225	   225	            out.append(f"{prefix}{ns[0]}…t{ns[-1]}")
226	   226	        else:
227	   227	            out.append(prefix + ",t".join(str(n) for n in ns))
228	   228	    return out + sorted(other)

237	   237	    try:
238	   238	        with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
239	   239	            raw = fh.read()
240	   240	    except OSError as e:
241	   241	        raise Fail(f"cannot read suite {path}: {e.strerror}")
242	   242	    try:
243	   243	        suite = json.loads(raw)
244	   244	    except ValueError:
245	   245	        try:
246	   246	            out = subprocess.run(["yq", "-o=json", ".", path], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
247	   247	            suite = json.loads(out)
248	   248	        except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError, ValueError):
249	   249	            raise Fail(f"cannot parse suite {path} (YAML needs yq v4 on PATH)")
250	   250	    if not isinstance(suite, dict) or not isinstance(suite.get("arms"), list) or not isinstance(suite.get("rules"), dict):
251	   251	        raise Fail(f"suite {path} has no arms[] or rules block")
252	   252	    lines, inside = [], False
253	   253	    for line in raw.splitlines():
254	   254	        if re.match(r"^rules:", line):
255	   255	            inside = True
256	   256	        elif inside and line.strip() and not line[0].isspace() and not line.startswith("#"):
257	   257	            break
258	   258	        if inside:
259	   259	            lines.append(line)
260	   260	    while lines and not lines[-1].strip():
261	   261	        lines.pop()
262	   262	    rules_text = "\n".join(lines) if lines else json.dumps({"rules": suite["rules"]}, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
263	   263	    return suite, rules_text

283	   283	                if not isinstance(row, dict):

376	   376	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- the analysis
377	   377	class Analysis:
378	   378	    def __init__(self, suite, rows, mans, args, cap_excluded):
379	   379	        self.suite, self.rules, self.args = suite, suite["rules"], args
380	   380	        self.cap_excluded = cap_excluded
381	   381	        self.arms = {a["id"]: a for a in suite["arms"] if isinstance(a, dict) and a.get("id")}
382	   382	        ex = self.rules.get("exclusion") or {}
383	   383	        self.ex_statuses = set(ex.get("statuses") or []) | set(DEC0417_EXCLUDED)
384	   384	        self.guard = float(ex.get("inconclusive_above_share", 0.25))
385	   385	        self.listed = []        # rows that never enter a decision, with the reason
386	   386	        self.excluded = []      # excluded rows (status/reason), superseded included
387	   387	        self.cells = {}         # (arm, task) -> {trial: {"valid": row|None, "rows": [...]}}
388	   388	        self.task_type = {}
389	   389	        self.task_defects = {}
390	   390	        self.arm_rows = {}
391	   391	        for row in rows:
392	   392	            seeded = row.get("defects_seeded")
393	   393	            if isinstance(seeded, int) and not isinstance(seeded, bool) and seeded > 0:
394	   394	                self.task_defects[row["task_id"]] = max(self.task_defects.get(row["task_id"], 0), seeded)
395	   395	        for row in rows:
396	   396	            self._classify(row, mans)
397	   397	        for (arm, task), trials in self.cells.items():
398	   398	            for t, cell in trials.items():
399	   399	                valid = [x for x in cell["rows"] if x["_valid"]]
400	   400	                cell["valid"] = valid[-1] if valid else None
401	   401	                for x in cell["rows"]:
402	   402	                    if x["_valid"] and x is not cell["valid"]:
403	   403	                        self.excluded.append(self._exrow(x, f"duplicate cell; superseded by {cell['valid']['run_id']}",
404	   404	                                                         counted=False))
405	   405	                    elif not x["_valid"]:
406	   406	                        sup = f"; superseded by {cell['valid']['run_id']}" if cell["valid"] else ""
407	   407	                        self.excluded.append(self._exrow(x, x["_reason"] + sup, counted=not cell["valid"]))
408	   408	
409	   409	    @staticmethod
410	   410	    def _exrow(x, reason, counted):
411	   411	        return {"run_id": x["run_id"], "arm": x["arm"], "task_id": x["task_id"], "trial": x["trial"],
412	   412	                "status": x["status"], "reason": reason, "cell_excluded": counted}
413	   413	
414	   414	    def applies(self, arm, ttype):
415	   415	        types = self.arms[arm].get("task_types") or []
416	   416	        return "all" in types or ttype in types or ("build" in types and ttype in BUILD_TYPES)
417	   417	
418	   418	    def primaries(self, arm):
419	   419	        types = self.arms[arm].get("task_types") or []
420	   420	        pba = self.rules.get("primaries_by_arm") or {}
421	   421	        if "all" in types or REVIEW in types:
422	   422	            return list(pba.get("all_types") or [PASS, CATCH])
423	   423	        return list(pba.get("build_only") or [PASS])
424	   424	
425	   425	    def _classify(self, row, mans):
426	   426	        arm, task, ttype = row["arm"], row["task_id"], row["task_type"]
427	   427	        m = mans.get(row["batch"])
428	   428	        if m is None:
429	   429	            return self.listed.append((row, "no manifest for batch " + row["batch"]))
430	   430	        amap = m.get("arm_map") or {}
431	   431	        if isinstance(amap, dict) and row["run_id"] in amap and amap[row["run_id"]] != arm:
432	   432	            raise Fail(f"{row['_where']}: row {row['run_id']} arm {arm} disagrees with "
433	   433	                       f"{m['_path']} arm_map ({amap[row['run_id']]})")
434	   434	        if m.get("smoke") is True:
435	   435	            return self.listed.append((row, "smoke batch " + row["batch"]))
436	   436	        if arm not in self.arms or self.arms[arm].get("absent"):
437	   437	            return self.listed.append((row, f"arm {arm} is not run by the suite"))
438	   438	        if ttype not in BUILD_TYPES and ttype != REVIEW:
439	   439	            return self.listed.append((row, f"unknown task_type {ttype}"))
440	   440	        if not self.applies(arm, ttype):
441	   441	            return self.listed.append((row, f"not applicable: {arm} does not run {ttype} tasks"))
442	   442	        self.task_type[task] = ttype
443	   443	        self.arm_rows.setdefault(arm, []).append(row)
444	   444	        st = row["status"]
445	   445	        reason = None
446	   446	        if st in self.ex_statuses:
447	   447	            reason = st
448	   448	        elif self.args.exclude_degraded and row.get("degraded") is True:
449	   449	            reason = "degraded: " + str(row.get("degraded_reason") or "no reason recorded")
450	   450	        elif st not in SCORING:
451	   451	            reason = "status " + st
452	   452	        elif st == "cap_failure" and self.cap_excluded:
453	   453	            reason = "cap_failure (sensitivity figure)"
454	   454	        elif st != "cap_failure":
455	   455	            if ttype == REVIEW and not isinstance(row.get(CATCH), (int, float)):
456	   456	                reason = "ungraded (defect_catch_rate null)"
457	   457	            elif ttype != REVIEW and not isinstance(row.get(PASS), (int, float)):
458	   458	                reason = "ungraded (hidden_test_pass_rate null)"
459	   459	        row["_valid"] = reason is None
460	   460	        row["_reason"] = reason
461	   461	        cell = self.cells.setdefault((arm, task), {}).setdefault(row["trial"], {"valid": None, "rows": []})
462	   462	        cell["rows"].append(row)
463	   463	
464	   464	    # -- scores
465	   465	    def pass_score(self, row):
466	   466	        return 0.0 if row["status"] == "cap_failure" else float(row[PASS])
467	   467	
468	   468	    def catch_task_score(self, row):
469	   469	        return 0.0 if row["status"] == "cap_failure" else float(row[CATCH])
470	   470	
471	   471	    def defect_vector(self, row):
472	   472	        n = self.task_defects.get(row["task_id"], 0)
473	   473	        if n <= 0:
474	   474	            return None, "none"
475	   475	        if row["status"] == "cap_failure":
476	   476	            return [0.0] * n, "cap"
477	   477	        missed = row.get("defects_missed")
478	   478	        if missed is None and isinstance(row.get("recall"), dict):
479	   479	            missed = row["recall"].get("missed")
480	   480	        if isinstance(missed, list) and all(isinstance(x, str) for x in missed):
481	   481	            ms = set(missed)
482	   482	            return [0.0 if f"d{k}" in ms else 1.0 for k in range(1, n + 1)], "ids"
483	   483	        return [float(row[CATCH])] * n, "rate"
484	   484	
485	   485	    # -- shares
486	   486	    def excluded_share(self, arm):
487	   487	        cells = [c for (a, _), trials in self.cells.items() if a == arm for c in trials.values()]
488	   488	        if not cells:
489	   489	            return None, 0, 0
490	   490	        ex = sum(1 for c in cells if c["valid"] is None)
491	   491	        return ex / len(cells), ex, len(cells)

493	   493	    # -- one paired comparison of `arm` against `ctrl` on one primary
494	   494	    def compare(self, arm, ctrl, metric, seed):
495	   495	        types = (REVIEW,) if metric == CATCH else BUILD_TYPES
496	   496	        tasks = sorted({t for (a, t) in self.cells if a in (arm, ctrl) and self.task_type.get(t) in types})
497	   497	        res = {"metric": metric, "arm": arm, "control": ctrl, "unit": "tasks", "pairs": [], "unpaired": [],
498	   498	               "dropped": [], "diffs": [], "task_diffs": [], "defect_identity": set()}
499	   499	        for task in tasks:
500	   500	            ca, cc = self.cells.get((arm, task), {}), self.cells.get((ctrl, task), {})
501	   501	            drop = sorted(t for t in set(ca) | set(cc)
502	   502	                          if (t in ca and ca[t]["valid"] is None) or (t in cc and cc[t]["valid"] is None))
503	   503	            for t in drop:
504	   504	                for side, cs in ((arm, ca), (ctrl, cc)):
505	   505	                    if t in cs and cs[t]["valid"] is not None:
506	   506	                        res["dropped"].append({"task_id": task, "trial": t, "arm": side,
507	   507	                                               "run_id": cs[t]["valid"]["run_id"]})
508	   508	            va = [ca[t]["valid"] for t in sorted(ca) if t not in drop]
509	   509	            vc = [cc[t]["valid"] for t in sorted(cc) if t not in drop]
510	   510	            if not va or not vc:

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# ablation-report.py — the cycle-130 ablation report (PRD FR-8, SDD §5.12, §4.2)
     4	#
     5	# Reads runs.jsonl rows (SDD §3.1, ablation-row.sh), the batch MANIFEST.json files
     6	# (SDD §3.4, run-ablation.sh) and the suite file (evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml:
     7	# arms[], trials, cut_ladder, priority and the pre-registered `rules` block, D-A5),
     8	# applies the pre-registered rules to every component arm (A2 … A7) against the
     9	# control a1_full, checks H1 (a1_full vs a0_bare) and the A4 sensitivity rule, and
    10	# writes report.md (and a --json twin with the same numbers).
    11	#
    12	# Usage:
    13	#   ablation-report.py --runs F [--runs F ...] --manifests DIR [--manifests DIR ...]
    14	#                      --suite F --out report.md [--json report.json]
    15	#                      [--seed 20261015] [--resamples N] [--level L]
    16	#                      [--exclude-degraded true|false] [--partial]
    17	#                      [--cuts F] [--not-run CSV]
    18	#
    19	# Options:
    20	#   --runs F            a runs.jsonl file (repeatable). Every non-blank line is one row
    21	#                       and must carry schema_version 1 (an integer, or a "1.x" string);
    22	#                       a row with another major, no schema_version, or a line that is not
    23	#                       a JSON object stops the report (exit 2, naming file:line and run_id).
    24	#                       A run_id seen twice keeps its last row (the earlier one is listed).
    25	#   --manifests DIR     a directory searched recursively (symlinks not followed) for
    26	#                       MANIFEST.json files (repeatable). Each gives a batch's provenance:
    27	#                       batch, arm_map, shuffle_seed, source_commit, suite_manifest_sha256,
    28	#                       suite_version, pre_registration_ref, cli_version (top level or
    29	#                       executor.cli_version), image_digest, smoke. A manifest with an
    30	#                       unknown schema_version major, two manifests claiming one batch, or
    31	#                       an arm_map entry disagreeing with a row's arm → exit 2.
    32	#   --suite F           the suite file: YAML read through `yq -o=json` (mikefarah yq v4,
    33	#                       as arms-report.py does), or JSON when the file parses as JSON.
    34	#                       The Method section quotes its `rules:` block verbatim.
    35	#   --out F             report.md (the only files written are --out and --json; a symlink
    36	#                       at either path is refused)
    37	#   --json F            the JSON twin (schema_version 1)
    38	#   --seed N            bootstrap seed (default 20261015); every interval uses its own
    39	#                       random.Random(seed), so a figure does not depend on which other
    40	#                       arms are present
    41	#   --resamples N       default rules.bootstrap.resamples (10,000); a value other than the
    42	#                       pre-registered one is marked in the header
    43	#   --level L           default rules.bootstrap.level (0.90); same marking
    44	#   --exclude-degraded  true (default) | false: rows with degraded: true are excluded
    45	#                       pairwise (rules.exclusion.statuses names `degraded`)
    46	#   --partial           prints "PARTIAL — rows so far, no decision is final"; exit 1 when no
    47	#                       comparison (A2–A7, H1, A4) has a valid pair on every primary it uses
    48	#   --cuts F            a JSON list of {arm, reason, figure[, state]} the lead recorded;
    49	#                       arm is an id (a5_no_flatline) or a label (A5); state is not_run_cut
    50	#                       (default) or inconclusive_by_power (a pre-declared power cut)
    51	#   --not-run CSV       arm ids or labels read as Not run (cut) with figure "--not-run"
    52	#
    53	# Row treatment (DEC-0393, DEC-0417):
    54	#   not decided, listed  rows of a smoke batch (manifest smoke: true), rows whose batch has
    55	#                        no manifest, rows of an arm the suite does not run (absent or
    56	#                        unknown), rows on a task type outside the arm's task_types
    57	#                        (applicability refusals; not counted in the excluded share)
    58	#   excluded pairwise    status in rules.exclusion.statuses plus transport_error and
    59	#                        infrastructure_error (DEC-0417), degraded: true (with
    60	#                        --exclude-degraded true), and a scoring status whose primary is
    61	#                        null (ungraded); the task-trial cell leaves BOTH arms of every
    62	#                        comparison it is in; a cell holding a valid row (a rerun) is valid
    63	#   cap_failure          0 on every applicable primary (pass rate 0, every defect missed)
    64	#   completed, agent_error  score what the row holds (hidden_test_pass_rate; defects)
    65	#   The sensitivity figure repeats the comparison with cap_failure excluded pairwise
    66	#   instead of scored 0; no decision reads it.
    67	#
    68	# Statistics (pre-registered in the suite's rules block; formulas in the Method section):
    69	#   pass rate unit  the task: per task, the mean over its valid trials, arm minus a1_full
    70	#   catch-rate unit the defect: per review-catch task and defect dK, the share of the
    71	#                   arm's valid trials that caught it, arm minus a1_full; per-defect ids
    72	#                   come from the row's `defects_missed` (or `recall.missed`) list of dK
    73	#                   ids when present, else each defect of the task takes the row's
    74	#                   defect_catch_rate (aggregate rows); the task-level figure is also
    75	#                   reported (rules.bootstrap.also_report) and decides nothing
    76	#   interval        percentile bootstrap of the mean paired difference: `resamples`
    77	#                   resamples with replacement, linear interpolation between order
    78	#                   statistics, [lo, hi] = the (1-level)/2 and 1-(1-level)/2 quantiles
    79	#   d               the mean of the paired differences (not the bootstrap mean)
    80	#   c, w            cost and wall-clock delta in percent against a1_full,
    81	#                   (mean_arm − mean_a1) / mean_a1 × 100, over the per-task means of the
    82	#                   cells the primaries paired
    83	#   MDE             (z(1−(1−level)/2) + z(0.90)) × sd(paired diffs) / sqrt(n): the smallest
    84	#                   true mean difference a paired test at the report level detects with 0.90
    85	#                   power at the available n; n < 2 → n/a
    86	#   comparisons     every predicate compares values rounded to 9 decimals, so a planted
    87	#                   −0.03 reads −0.03 and not −0.030000000000000027
    88	#
    89	# Decision per arm (rules.predicates, first match, DEC-0416, with DEC-0393's guard first):
    90	#   the degradation guard (excluded share > rules.exclusion.inconclusive_above_share →
    91	#   inconclusive, labelled Inconclusive-by-degradation, whatever the interval) →
    92	#   investigate → keep → inconclusive (d < -0.03 or no valid pair) → remove → simplify. Then: an arm named by --cuts / --not-run reads
    93	#   Not run (cut) or Inconclusive-by-power with the lead's figure; an arm whose MDE on an
    94	#   applicable primary exceeds rules.mde_cut and whose predicate outcome is remove or
    95	#   simplify reads Inconclusive-by-power with the figure (a null result the sample could
    96	#   not have detected); A8 (absent: true) reads component-absent with the suite evidence.
    97	#
    98	# Exit codes:
    99	#   0  report written
   100	#   1  --partial and no decidable comparison (the report is still written)
   101	#   2  usage error, unreadable input, unknown schema major, provenance conflict
   102	#
   103	# Tested by evals/tests/ablation-report.bats (planted rows generated by
   104	# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-report/gen-fixtures.py).
   105	# =============================================================================
   106	import argparse
   107	import json
   108	import math
   109	import os
   110	import random
   111	import re
   112	import statistics
   113	import subprocess
   114	import sys
   115	
   116	VERSION = "1.0.0"
   117	REPORT_SCHEMA = 1
   118	ROW_SCHEMA_MAJOR = 1
   119	MANIFEST_SCHEMA_MAJOR = 1
   120	CONTROL = "a1_full"
   121	BARE = "a0_bare"
   122	SENSITIVITY_ARM = "a4_no_gates"
   123	BUILD_TYPES = ("feature-build", "bug-fix", "refactor")
   124	REVIEW = "review-catch"
   125	PASS = "hidden_test_pass_rate"
   126	CATCH = "defect_catch_rate"
   127	DEC0417_EXCLUDED = ("transport_error", "infrastructure_error")
   128	SCORING = ("completed", "agent_error", "cap_failure")
   129	POWER = 0.90
   130	DISPLAY = {"investigate": "Investigate", "keep": "Keep", "inconclusive": "Inconclusive",
   131	           "remove": "Remove", "simplify": "Simplify", "not_run_cut": "Not run (cut)",
   132	           "inconclusive_by_power": "Inconclusive-by-power", "component_absent": "component-absent",
   133	           "no_rows": "no rows"}
   134	PARTIAL_LINE = "PARTIAL — rows so far, no decision is final"
   135	SENS_LABEL = "sensitivity (cap failures excluded) — no decision uses this"

   138	class Fail(Exception):
   139	    pass

   142	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- small helpers
   143	def r9(x):
   144	    return None if x is None else round(x, 9)
   145	
   146	
   147	def mean(xs):
   148	    xs = [x for x in xs if x is not None]
   149	    return sum(xs) / len(xs) if xs else None
   150	
   151	
   152	def f3(x):
   153	    return "n/a" if x is None else f"{x:+.3f}" if x != 0 else "0.000"
   154	
   155	
   156	def u3(x):
   157	    return "n/a" if x is None else f"{x:.3f}"
   158	
   159	
   160	def pct(x):
   161	    return "n/a" if x is None else f"{x:+.1f} %"

   163	
   164	def j6(x):
   165	    return None if x is None else round(x, 6)

   168	def schema_major(v):
   169	    if isinstance(v, bool):
   170	        return None
   171	    if isinstance(v, int):
   172	        return v
   173	    if isinstance(v, float) and v.is_integer():
   174	        return int(v)
   175	    if isinstance(v, str) and re.fullmatch(r"\d+(\.\d+)*", v):
   176	        return int(v.split(".")[0])
   177	    return None

   180	def percentile(sorted_xs, q):
   181	    """Linear interpolation between order statistics (numpy's default 'linear')."""
   182	    n = len(sorted_xs)
   183	    if n == 0:
   184	        return None
   185	    pos = q * (n - 1)
   186	    lo = int(math.floor(pos))
   187	    hi = min(lo + 1, n - 1)
   188	    frac = pos - lo
   189	    return sorted_xs[lo] + (sorted_xs[hi] - sorted_xs[lo]) * frac
   190

   192	def bootstrap(diffs, resamples, level, seed):
   193	    if not diffs:
   194	        return None, None
   195	    rng = random.Random(seed)
   196	    n = len(diffs)
   197	    means = sorted(sum(rng.choices(diffs, k=n)) / n for _ in range(resamples))
   198	    a = (1.0 - level) / 2.0
   199	    return percentile(means, a), percentile(means, 1.0 - a)
   200	
   201	
   202	def mde(diffs, level):
   203	    if len(diffs) < 2:
   204	        return None
   205	    nd = statistics.NormalDist()
   206	    z = nd.inv_cdf(1.0 - (1.0 - level) / 2.0) + nd.inv_cdf(POWER)
   207	    return z * statistics.stdev(diffs) / math.sqrt(len(diffs))

   210	def collapse(run_ids):
   211	    """batch-arm-task-t1, -t2, -t3 → batch-arm-task-t1…t3 (non-contiguous: t1,t3)."""
   212	    groups, other = {}, []
   213	    for rid in run_ids:
   214	        m = re.fullmatch(r"(.*-t)(\d+)", rid)
   215	        if m:
   216	            groups.setdefault(m.group(1), []).append(int(m.group(2)))
   217	        else:
   218	            other.append(rid)
   219	    out = []
   220	    for prefix in sorted(groups):
   221	        ns = sorted(set(groups[prefix]))
   222	        if len(ns) == 1:
   223	            out.append(f"{prefix}{ns[0]}")
   224	        elif len(ns) >= 3 and ns == list(range(ns[0], ns[-1] + 1)):
   225	            out.append(f"{prefix}{ns[0]}…t{ns[-1]}")
   226	        else:
   227	            out.append(prefix + ",t".join(str(n) for n in ns))
   228	    return out + sorted(other)

   235	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- inputs
   236	def load_suite(path):
   237	    try:
   238	        with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
   239	            raw = fh.read()
   240	    except OSError as e:
   241	        raise Fail(f"cannot read suite {path}: {e.strerror}")
   242	    try:
   243	        suite = json.loads(raw)
   244	    except ValueError:
   245	        try:
   246	            out = subprocess.run(["yq", "-o=json", ".", path], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
   247	            suite = json.loads(out)
   248	        except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError, ValueError):
   249	            raise Fail(f"cannot parse suite {path} (YAML needs yq v4 on PATH)")
   250	    if not isinstance(suite, dict) or not isinstance(suite.get("arms"), list) or not isinstance(suite.get("rules"), dict):
   251	        raise Fail(f"suite {path} has no arms[] or rules block")
   252	    lines, inside = [], False
   253	    for line in raw.splitlines():
   254	        if re.match(r"^rules:", line):
   255	            inside = True
   256	        elif inside and line.strip() and not line[0].isspace() and not line.startswith("#"):
   257	            break
   258	        if inside:
   259	            lines.append(line)
   260	    while lines and not lines[-1].strip():
   261	        lines.pop()
   262	    rules_text = "\n".join(lines) if lines else json.dumps({"rules": suite["rules"]}, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
   263	    return suite, rules_text

   266	def load_rows(paths):
   267	    rows, dup = [], []
   268	    seen = {}
   269	    for path in paths:
   270	        try:
   271	            fh = open(path, encoding="utf-8")
   272	        except OSError as e:
   273	            raise Fail(f"cannot read --runs {path}: {e.strerror}")
   274	        with fh:
   275	            for n, line in enumerate(fh, 1):
   276	                if not line.strip():
   277	                    continue
   278	                where = f"{path}:{n}"
   279	                try:
   280	                    row = json.loads(line)
   281	                except ValueError:
   282	                    raise Fail(f"{where}: line is not valid JSON")
   283	                if not isinstance(row, dict):
   284	                    raise Fail(f"{where}: row is not a JSON object")
   285	                rid = row.get("run_id")
   286	                if "schema_version" not in row:
   287	                    raise Fail(f"{where}: row {rid} has no schema_version (1 required)")
   288	                major = schema_major(row.get("schema_version"))
   289	                if major != ROW_SCHEMA_MAJOR:
   290	                    raise Fail(f"{where}: row {rid} has schema_version {row.get('schema_version')!r}; "
   291	                               f"this reader knows major {ROW_SCHEMA_MAJOR} only")
   292	                for k, ty in (("run_id", str), ("batch", str), ("arm", str), ("task_id", str),
   293	                              ("task_type", str), ("status", str)):
   294	                    if not isinstance(row.get(k), ty) or not row.get(k):
   295	                        raise Fail(f"{where}: row {rid} has no {k}")
   296	                if isinstance(row.get("trial"), bool) or not isinstance(row.get("trial"), int):
   297	                    raise Fail(f"{where}: row {rid} has no integer trial")
   298	                row = dict(row)
   299	                row["_where"] = where
   300	                if rid in seen:
   301	                    dup.append({"run_id": rid, "kept": where, "dropped": seen[rid]["_where"]})
   302	                    rows.remove(seen[rid])
   303	                seen[rid] = row
   304	                rows.append(row)
   305	    return rows, dup

   308	def load_manifests(dirs):
   309	    mans = {}
   310	    for d in dirs:
   311	        if not os.path.isdir(d):
   312	            raise Fail(f"--manifests {d} is not a directory")
   313	        for root, subdirs, files in os.walk(d, followlinks=False):
   314	            subdirs.sort()
   315	            if "MANIFEST.json" not in files:
   316	                continue
   317	            p = os.path.join(root, "MANIFEST.json")
   318	            if os.path.islink(p):
   319	                raise Fail(f"{p} is a symlink")
   320	            try:
   321	                with open(p, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
   322	                    m = json.load(fh)
   323	            except (OSError, ValueError):
   324	                raise Fail(f"cannot read manifest {p}")
   325	            if not isinstance(m, dict):
   326	                raise Fail(f"manifest {p} is not a JSON object")
   327	            if "schema_version" in m and schema_major(m["schema_version"]) != MANIFEST_SCHEMA_MAJOR:
   328	                raise Fail(f"manifest {p} has schema_version {m['schema_version']!r}; "
   329	                           f"this reader knows major {MANIFEST_SCHEMA_MAJOR} only")
   330	            batch = m.get("batch") or m.get("batch_name")
   331	            if not isinstance(batch, str) or not batch:
   332	                raise Fail(f"manifest {p} names no batch")
   333	            if batch in mans:
   334	                raise Fail(f"two manifests claim batch {batch}: {mans[batch]['_path']} and {p}")
   335	            m = dict(m)
   336	            m["_path"] = p
   337	            mans[batch] = m
   338	    if not mans:
   339	        raise Fail("no MANIFEST.json under " + ", ".join(dirs))

   343	def load_cuts(path, not_run, arm_ids, labels):
   344	    cuts = {}
   345	
   346	    def resolve(a):
   347	        a = str(a).strip()
   348	        if a in arm_ids:
   349	            return a
   350	        if a.upper() in labels:
   351	            return labels[a.upper()]
   352	        raise Fail(f"cut names unknown arm {a}")
   353	
   354	    if path:
   355	        try:
   356	            with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
   357	                data = json.load(fh)
   358	        except (OSError, ValueError):
   359	            raise Fail(f"cannot read --cuts {path}")
   360	        if not isinstance(data, list):
   361	            raise Fail(f"--cuts {path} is not a JSON list")
   362	        for c in data:
   363	            if not isinstance(c, dict) or "arm" not in c:
   364	                raise Fail(f"--cuts {path}: an entry has no arm")
   365	            state = c.get("state", "not_run_cut")
   366	            if state not in ("not_run_cut", "inconclusive_by_power"):
   367	                raise Fail(f"--cuts {path}: state {state} is not not_run_cut|inconclusive_by_power")
   368	            cuts[resolve(c["arm"])] = {"state": state, "reason": str(c.get("reason", "")),
   369	                                       "figure": str(c.get("figure", "")), "source": "--cuts"}
   370	    for a in [x for x in (not_run or "").split(",") if x.strip()]:
   371	        cuts.setdefault(resolve(a), {"state": "not_run_cut", "reason": "--not-run", "figure": "--not-run",
   372	                                     "source": "--not-run"})
   373	    return cuts

   376	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- the analysis
   377	class Analysis:
   378	    def __init__(self, suite, rows, mans, args, cap_excluded):
   379	        self.suite, self.rules, self.args = suite, suite["rules"], args
   380	        self.cap_excluded = cap_excluded
   381	        self.arms = {a["id"]: a for a in suite["arms"] if isinstance(a, dict) and a.get("id")}
   382	        ex = self.rules.get("exclusion") or {}
   383	        self.ex_statuses = set(ex.get("statuses") or []) | set(DEC0417_EXCLUDED)
   384	        self.guard = float(ex.get("inconclusive_above_share", 0.25))
   385	        self.listed = []        # rows that never enter a decision, with the reason
   386	        self.excluded = []      # excluded rows (status/reason), superseded included
   387	        self.cells = {}         # (arm, task) -> {trial: {"valid": row|None, "rows": [...]}}

   582	    def decide(self, arm, comps, c, w, share):
   583	        T = float(self.rules.get("threshold_points", 0.03))
   584	        C = float(self.rules.get("cost_lower_pct", 15))
   585	        P = [p for p in comps if p["n"] > 0]
   586	        nopair = len(P) < len(comps)
   587	        name = lambda p: p["metric"]  # noqa: E731
   588	        if share is not None and r9(share) > self.guard:
   589	            # DEC-0393: the degradation guard reads first, whatever the interval (lead's ruling, Sprint 260)
   590	            clause = f"excluded share {share:.3f} > {self.guard:g}"
   591	            return "inconclusive", f"inconclusive (degradation guard, evaluated first): {clause}", [clause]
   592	        hits = [name(p) for p in P if r9(p["lo"]) > 0]
   593	        if hits:
   594	            return "investigate", f"investigate: any applicable primary has lo > 0 ({', '.join(hits)})", []
   595	        hits = [name(p) for p in P if r9(p["d"]) < -T and r9(p["hi"]) < 0]
   596	        if hits:
   597	            return "keep", f"keep: any applicable primary has d < -{T:g} and hi < 0 ({', '.join(hits)})", []
   598	        clauses = []
   599	        hits = [name(p) for p in P if r9(p["d"]) < -T]
   600	        if hits:
   601	            clauses.append(f"d < -{T:g} ({', '.join(hits)})")

   606	        cost_ok = (c is not None and r9(c) <= -C) or (w is not None and r9(w) <= -C)

     1	#!/usr/bin/env bats
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# evals/tests/ablation-report.bats — cycle-130 Sprint 260 Task 3.8 (AC-3.10; PRD AC-8.1–8.3;
     4	# SDD §5.12; DEC-0393, DEC-0399, DEC-0400, DEC-0416, DEC-0417, DEC-0434, DEC-0435)
     5	#
     6	# ablation-report.py on planted rows: fixtures/ablation-report/gen-fixtures.py writes four
     7	# scenarios (main, boundary, exclusions, partial; the header there lists every planted
     8	# number) into the file tmpdir; setup_file builds the three full reports once against the
     9	# real suite file evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml.
    10	# =============================================================================
    11	
    12	setup_file() {
    13	  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
    14	  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    15	  export REPO_ROOT
    16	  export REPORT="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/ablation-report.py"
    17	  export SUITE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
    18	  export FX="$BATS_FILE_TMPDIR/fx"
    19	  mkdir -p "$FX"
    20	  python3 -I "$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/ablation-report/gen-fixtures.py" "$FX"
    21	  for s in main boundary exclusions; do
    22	    python3 -I "$REPORT" --runs "$FX/$s/runs.jsonl" --manifests "$FX/$s/manifests" --suite "$SUITE" \
    23	      --out "$FX/$s/report.md" --json "$FX/$s/report.json" >/dev/null
    24	  done
    25	}
    26	
    27	setup() {
    28	  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ar.XXXXXX")"
    29	}
    30	
    31	teardown() {
    32	  find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
    33	  rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true

    37	  jq -r --arg a "$2" ".decisions[] | select(.arm == \$a) | $3" "$FX/$1/report.json"
    38	}

    41	  jq -r --arg a "$2" --arg m "$3" ".decisions[] | select(.arm == \$a) | .comparisons[] | select(.metric == \$m) | $4" "$FX/$1/report.json"
    42	}
    43	
    44	report() {  # report <scenario> <out-prefix> [extra args]
    45	  local s="$1" o="$2"; shift 2
    46	  run python3 -I "$REPORT" --runs "$FX/$s/runs.jsonl" --manifests "$FX/$s/manifests" --suite "$SUITE" \
    47	    --out "$o.md" --json "$o.json" "$@"

   398	@test "RAB-14 is_pipeline_transport_failure: only an agent_error whose failing phase shows a CLI transport signature (stderr, api_error_status, an is_error result) counts; the agent's own text, a non-failing phase and a completed run never do" {

HOME_WORD = re.compile(r"(?:(?<=^)|(?<=[\s=:'\"`(<>|;&,]))(?:~|\$HOME|\$\{HOME\})/")
HOME_PREFIXES = ("~/", "$HOME/", "${HOME}/")
SENSITIVE = re.compile(r"^/proc/(?:\d+|self|thread-self)/(?:environ|cmdline|maps|mem)(?:/|$)|^/var/run(?:/|$)")
SYS_DIRS = ["/dev", "/proc", "/sys", "/usr", "/bin", "/sbin", "/lib", "/lib64", "/etc", "/opt", "/var"]
ROOTS = ["/workspace", "/tmp", "/home/evaluser"] + SYS_DIRS
SENSITIVE_SINGLE = {"root", "home", "mnt", "media", "srv"}
import os
EXECUTOR = "container"
def home_word_outside(): return EXECUTOR == "host"
def outside(p, roots):
    if p.startswith(HOME_PREFIXES): return home_word_outside()
    p = os.path.normpath(p)
    if SENSITIVE.match(p): return True
    return not any(p == r or p.startswith(r.rstrip("/") + "/") for r in roots)
def after_closing_quote(body, pos):
    if pos < 2 or body[pos - 1] not in "'\"": return False
    before = body[pos - 2]
    return not (before.isspace() or before in "=(<>|;&,")
def in_quotes(body, pos):
    seg = body[:pos]
    return seg.count("'") % 2 == 1 or seg.count('"') % 2 == 1
HEREDOC = re.compile(r"<<-?\s*(['\"]?)([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\1[^\n]*\n(?:.*?\n)*?\s*\2[ \t]*(?=\n|$)", re.S)
def strip_heredocs(val): return HEREDOC.sub("<<HEREDOC", val)

    return None
